title: Australia’s Gold Rush, Seales’ heroics, Essex history & UEFA oppose FIFA plan
byline: From medal dominance to cricket heroics, historic milestones and football controversies, the world of sport produced another action-packed day. Australia, West Indies, Essex Cricket and UEFA all made headlines in the latest global sports roundup.

title: Sri Lanka pharma sets sights on US$ 1.8tn global market
byline: Sri Lanka’s pharmaceutical manufacturing industry is pushing to evolve from an import-substitution model into a multi-billion dollar export engine, eyeing a slice of the US$ 1.8 trillion global market.

title: Ibrahim Zadran’s 95 powers Jaffna Kings to win over Colombo Kaps
byline: Jaffna Kings boosted their Lanka Premier League 2026 playoff hopes with a convincing 19-run victory over Colombo Kaps at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium, powered by Ibrahim Zadran’s brilliant half-century and Dilshan Madushanka’s match-winning bowling spell.

title: Colombo Dockyard returns to profit as ship repair earnings surge
byline: Colombo Dockyard PLC swung to a profit in the three months through June as stronger ship repair earnings and lower finance costs outweighed a drop in revenue.

title: BASL to hold special General Meeting on proposed judicial retirement age increase
byline: The Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) will convene a Special General Meeting in Colombo today (29) to discuss the government’s proposed move to increase the retirement age of judges.

title: Japan quake toll rises to 13 as rescuers haul people from collapsed mall
byline: Rescuers were frantically searching on Wednesday for survivors of ​a 7.1-magnitude earthquake that shook southern Japan, killing at least 13 people, knocking out power to thousands of homes and rupturing roads across the region.

title: Anti-Corruption Unit constable dead in apparent suicide
byline: A police constable has died by suspected suicide after shooting himself with his official service firearm.

title: Company director arrested over alleged housing investment scam
byline: A director of a private company has been arrested by the Mirihana Special Crimes Investigation Division for allegedly defrauding members of the public by promising houses and land under an easy payment scheme.

title: France evacuates 4,000 as Gironde wildfire faces renewed heat threat
byline: French authorities ordered nearly 4,000 people to evacuate tourist sites on the Atlantic coast on Tuesday as returning heat threatened firefighters’ fragile hold on a vast wildfire west of Bordeaux. The new evacuations added to a wildfire crisis across south-western Europe, where fires in France and Spain have forced about 330,000 people to leave their homes and holiday accommodation.

title: India summons top Meta executive after PM Modi’s video briefly blocked
byline: The government has summoned Meta’s public policy chief after a video posted by Prime Minister Narendra Modi was briefly removed by Facebook in India, sources said. The video in question was uploaded by PM Modi last week – at the height of the Cockroach Janta Party’s protest against leaked exam papers.

title: Iran to get Chinese shoulder-launched missile systems in weeks: Reuters
byline: Iran is expected to receive within weeks a first shipment out of up to 400 Chinese-made shoulder-fired air-defence missile launchers, three sources familiar with the deal told ​Reuters, as it rebuilds its defences amid war with the United States.

title: BASL special general meeting begins amid large lawyer turnout
byline: The Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) Special General Meeting of its General Membership commenced a short while ago at the BASL Head Office in Hulftsdorp, with a large number of lawyers in attendance.

title: Technical fault delays KKS Intercity train; passengers face inconvenience
byline: Passengers travelling on the Kankesanthurai (KKS) Intercity Express faced delays and overcrowding today after the train developed a technical fault at the Veyangoda Railway Station.

title: Private hospital fined Rs. 500,000 for overcharging on blood test
byline: A private hospital in Vavuniya has been fined Rs. 500,000 for charging above the government-controlled price for a Full Blood Count (FBC) test.

title: BASL unanimously passes resolution against proposed judges’ retirement age amendment
byline: The Special General Meeting of the General Membership of the Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) today unanimously passed a resolution strongly opposing the proposed amendment to increase the retirement age of judges.

title: BASL was not consulted on proposed judges’ retirement age amendment: BASL President
byline: Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) President Rajeev Amarasuriya today said the BASL had not been consulted before the Government proceeded with the proposed constitutional amendment seeking to extend the retirement age of judges.

title: Reclaiming the Republic: Why True Judicial Efficiency Demands Systemic Reform Over Retirement Age Extensions
byline: A fundamental mistake in political thinking is confusing a raw democratic majority with a true constitutional republic.

title: Palestinian tourist killed in parasailing accident off Bentota
byline: A 31-year-old Palestinian woman was killed after a parasail reportedly crashed into the sea off the Bentota coast this evening (29), police said.
